note:
BH-9440. Total open PRs, every author together, that `bin/overlap-guard.sh --refresh ` reads into state/overlap-guard/

-prs.json. The refresh asks for one row more; if it comes back, the snapshot is cut, state/overlap-guard/

-prs.incomplete is written, one warn alert per project per UTC day goes out, and the guard DEFERs every launch on the project until a complete refresh deletes the marker. Capped at 999 (the REST seam stops at 10 pages). OVERLAP_PR_LIMIT stays the guard's own per-author read. Read as sched_num OVERLAP_REFRESH_PR_LIMIT 500 after lib_env_apply sibling-serial.
